ctx.x: So it was like a concert presentation.

A whole show opener. The closer came, I think Red Ryder would be the first. So you introduce him and when he got ready to play his number Jesse Hickenbotham and -- no, yeah, Jesse Hickenbotham and Georgie and another horn, the reed section, would come out and just step right up on the stage and play background so they'd have at least three horns.
And then they'd leave and he'd take it over, talking and doing his little things. And when he closed his last number, the same three horns would come back (inaudible).
